segments.ja128:1.1: Yo ve dhammaṃ dhajaṃ [dhammadhajaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] katvā, nigūḷho pāpamācare;
segments.ja128:1.3: Vissāsayitvā bhūtāni, biḷāraṃ nāma taṃ vatanti.

lines: Dhammaṃ dhajaṃ katvāti dasakusalakammapathadhammaṃ dhajaṃ karitvā, kūṭaṃ karonto viya ussāpetvā dassentoti attho.
Biḷāraṃ nāma taṃ vatanti taṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ dhajaṃ katvā raho pāpāni karontassa vataṃ kerāṭikavataṃ nāma hotīti attho.
